title: The Second Book of Sword Breath
summary: Builds on the first breathing drills with a surging cut and a calming edge for students who already hold a primer.

title: Treatise on the Edge Within
summary: A treatise on keeping qi inside the blade until the instant of the cut and letting it bloom on contact.

title: Handbook of the Guarding Blade Qi
summary: A handbook that turns the sword into a shell of qi that rolls blows aside and answers them in one motion.

title: Canon of the Following Edge
summary: A canon of linked cuts where each stroke leaves the blade in place for the next and the qi runs on unbroken.

title: A Treatise on Sword Light
summary: A treatise on letting sword qi flash bright along the steel to dazzle the eye and to speed the cut.

title: Workbook of the Bound Blade
summary: A workbook on catching and pinning an opponent's weapon with the crossed blade and with threads of sword qi.

title: The Cleansing Edge Handbook
summary: A handbook on using the clean line of sword qi to cut taint and bindings out of a wounded comrade.

title: Treatise on the Sensing Point
summary: A treatise on reading a stranger's reach and hands through the tip of the sword and cutting where the reading ends.
